title: Edmonton, here I come — starting my Ph.D. at UAlberta!
description: It's official: I'll be starting my Ph.D. in Computer Science at the University of Alberta in January 2027. Now I just have to survive my first Canadian winter.

title: We made the TikTok TechJam Grand Finals!
description: Our shopping copilot ARC made it all the way to the Grand Finals of TikTok TechJam 2026 — top 12 out of 600+ teams. Three very sleepless days, and somehow it all held together.

title: Made the Dean's List at NUS :)
description: Placed on the Dean's List of the School of Computing (top 5%). A nice little reward for a semester that did not feel nice at all.

title: ForestLLM, my work from my Microsoft internship, is out!!
description: "ForestLLM: Large Language Models Make Random Forest Great on Few-shot Tabular Learning" is finally on arXiv! Turns out you can let an LLM design a random forest and then never call it again at test time.

title: The Rakuten offer came through — new chapter!
description: Got the offer in October and joined Rakuten Asia, working on reasoning-augmented product search for conversational shopping, post-trained with reinforcement learning. Teaching a model to ask the right question is harder than it sounds.

title: NUS said yes — off to Singapore for my Master's!
description: The offer from the National University of Singapore came through, so I'm back in Singapore, this time for an M.Sc. in Computer Science.

title: Off to Beijing — I'm joining MSRA!
description: Starting a research internship with the DKI group at Microsoft Research Asia, working on LLMs for few-shot tabular learning. Excited (and a little terrified).

title: Wrapped up my time at 4Paradigm
description: Six months as an Applied Scientist on recommender systems and LLM post-training. It showed me what machine learning actually looks like once real users are involved.

title: ADFound got accepted by IEEE JBHI!
description: The acceptance email landed right in the middle of my time at 4Paradigm: ADFound was accepted by the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. I read it about four times to make sure.

title: Starting my first full-time job at 4Paradigm
description: Joining as an Applied Scientist in Shanghai, on recommender systems and LLM post-training. First real job, first real production system.

title: Graduated from Shandong University!
description: Four years of software engineering, wrapped up — B.Eng. in hand, ranked 3rd out of 96. Time to find out what the real world wants.

title: Landed in Singapore — research attachment at A*STAR
description: The SIPGA attachment kicked off at the Institute for Infocomm Research, working on uncertainty-based image-quality assessment for industrial defect detection. My first proper look at Singapore — turns out I'd be back.

title: Off to Hong Kong — visiting student at PolyU!
description: A semester in the Biomedical Engineering department at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, working on multimodal medical imaging for Alzheimer's disease. This is where the ADFound work began.

title: Got the SIPGA award from A*STAR!
description: Selected for the Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award, which comes with a research attachment at A*STAR starting in the new year. My first shot at doing research abroad.
